_note: Mirrors one paper portfolio onto a Saxo account. environment 'sim' is Saxo's practice system with fake money. Going live needs environment 'live' here AND the GitHub secret SAXO_ALLOW_LIVE set to the exact phrase in execute_saxo.py. Set enabled to false to stop all Saxo trading immediately. Differences smaller than min_trade_dkk are left alone (unless the model sells the whole holding), so rounding never costs a minimum fee.
